# atproto_account (Data Source)

Resolves a handle to the DID of its account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "atproto_account" "bob" {
  handle = "bob.bsky.social"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `handle` (String) Handle to resolve, such as `alice.bsky.social`.

### Read-Only

- `did` (String) DID of the account.
